checkpoints.description: [1/1] Looped foreign callees inline into their caller as full copies

impact_assessment.why: binary_gcd pays a per-iteration call to bgcd; the copy-free gate refused any looping callee, leaving call overhead in the hottest loop
impact_assessment.benefits: looped callees without calls/divisions become full inline copies; binary_gcd measured 191 -> 173-175 ms (-8.6%), closing on C 165-181
impact_assessment.risks: contract: copy emission must keep break/continue bound to the innermost loop of the copied body - emission-local stacks already carry them and sema guarantees innermost binding; dependency: none new; concurrency: none; state: hoist plans reserved homes for copies via _plan_foreign_copy homes|hoist_homes, no r13 collision
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first bytes tests (ForeignLoopCopyTest) plus repinned ForeignInlineTest loops-with-breaks cases, LOOP_COPY_PROGRAM end-to-end values, full 928-test suite, --save --compare gate exit 0

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Verification complete: 928 tests, 4/4 gates, ADR-048, benchmark gate exit 0
[1/3] Shift-through fusion: (a>>m)<<k lowers as and -2^k, and single-use copy args of shape name>>m forward into their use

impact_assessment.why: call_chain loses 30 percent to C entirely from the sar+shl chain in the inlined mix3 body (gcc folds (i>>2)<<2 into and -4 via full evaluation); the same shape is the standard floor-to-multiple idiom in real programs and crosses call boundaries in both nqueens and call_chain args
impact_assessment.benefits: call_chain 44.6 -> target near C 34.5 ms; nqueens argument shuffles slim; a general sound peephole in the language
impact_assessment.risks: contract: (a>>m)<<k == a & -(2^k) requires k>=m>=1, verified for signed negatives since sar sign-fill shifts out exactly when k>=m; a forwarded arg must only fire when the parameter occurs exactly once in the copy body and the shift user shape is verifiable at emission; dependency: reuses existing _logical_shift_shape machinery, no new deps; concurrency: none; state: provenance lives only inside one copy emission and must not leak across nested copies
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first bytes tests pinning the and-lowering and absence of sar in the copy region, e2e value tests against a Python wrap model with negative operands and k==m plus k>m, full suite + benchmark gate before commit

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Verified: 960 tests, 4/4 gates, ADR-049, gate exit 0; call_chain A/B within noise, mechanism recorded as wrong hypothesis
[1/1] slim per-call prologues: skip implicit return-zero when the body ends in return, clear only slots cleared_before_use cannot prove assigned, lower let/assign zero into a home as xor

impact_assessment.why: recursion-heavy nqueens pays a 6-7 instruction prologue per call; the copy path already proved both gates safe
impact_assessment.benefits: nqueens 25 ms toward C 22.6; every recursive call shrinks
impact_assessment.risks: contract: implicit zero guards fall-through margins; dependency: _cleared_before_use must stay a pure AST walk; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: zero kept whenever the last statement is no Return; only proven mechanisms ported; failing-first tests + full suite + benchmark gate

checkpoints.description: [1/1] delivered: 963 tests OK, checklists: passed (check exit 3 only for uncommitted work), benchmark gate exit 0, nqueens 25.0 to 23.4 ms same-window
[1/3] argv builtins: argc() and arg_byte(i, j) over GetCommandLineA; [2/3] stdin read_char() with a 4096-byte buffered static in writable .data; [3/3] dedicated benchmark twins + benchmark gate

impact_assessment.why: the language cannot react to the outside world: no stdin, no args, only print builtins; input is the first step of a usable language per the agreed roadmap
impact_assessment.benefits: programs can consume argv and stdin; string handling becomes reachable; one import and one writable-data extension
impact_assessment.risks: contract: argv[0] is the program path (C convention) and read_char returns -1 on EOF; dependency: GetStdHandle and GetCommandLineA join the import table, and .data gains labels after the IAT; concurrency: none; state: static cursor/count live in .data, zero-initialized by the loader
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first sema/codegen/e2e tests per builtin; buffered reads mean one ReadFile per 4096 bytes; benchmark twin set pins throughput equivalence; keep the existing print ABI untouched

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Input builtins land: argc, arg_byte and read_char with the static argv cache and 4096-byte stdin buffer, writable .data region after the IAT, benchmark twins argv_walk and char_stream in the harness, 997 tests OK, gate exit 0. ADR-051.

[1/3] Plan: M1 exit(code) builtin via the already-linked ExitProcess; M2 string literals (lexed str tokens with \ \" \n \t escapes, NUL-terminated deduped .rodata storage, value = literal address as i64) plus str_len, str_byte, print_str builtins; M3 benchmark twin for string reads and delivery.

impact_assessment.why: programs cannot fail with a message or compare text: without exit a check can only return a code upward, and without literals every test fixture is unreachable; both are the smallest steps that make the test suite writable in Cairn
impact_assessment.benefits: assert-style helpers become writable Cara programs themselves: print_str + str_len + str_byte cover message output, length checks and fixture scanning; exit gives fail-fast semantics with a nonzero exit code
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a string literal's value is its bytes' address (i64-typed like everything else), str_byte answers -1 only for negative j and callers bound with str_len, reading past the NUL stays inside .rodata and is documented; dependency: none new (WriteFile/ExitProcess already imported), rodata gains NUL-terminated blobs; concurrency: none; state: literals live in the read-only section the loader already maps
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests at every layer (lexer escapes, sema arities and the exit-is-not-a-value rule, codegen shape, e2e assert helper and exit propagation); data-dependent benchmark twin so no optimizer may fold the read; keep builtins non-redefinable per the existing E3012 check
